name: printstudio-pro
description: PrintStudio Pro - Enterprise Windows Print Previewer, Virtual Printer, PDF Merger & Imposition Suite

scripts.build:service: dotnet publish printer-service/PrinterService.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true
scripts.electron:dev: node scripts/ensure-sidecar.mjs && npm run build:electron-main && npm run build:preload && concurrently -k -s first "npm:dev:vite" "npm:dev:electron"
scripts.build:electron: npm run build:service && npm run build:preload && npm run build:electron-main && vite build && node scripts/prepare-win-build.mjs && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.build:electron:nosidecar: npm run build:preload && npm run build:electron-main && vite build && node scripts/prepare-win-build.mjs --allow-missing-sidecar && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.sidecar:publish: dotnet publish printer-service/PrinterService.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true
